coverage: I took the frontmatter description and every sentence, command line and inline comment of the body - the three driver-pack source sentences, all three model-detection PowerShell lines with their comments, the WinPE and VMD sentences, both DISM offline commands, both pnputil online commands, both task-sequence bullets, all three gotchas and the Verify checklist - splitting wrapped lines and compound sentences so that every command, flag, number (21HD, 11th gen) and behaviour is covered, and checked each against the three listed sources fetched today.
suggested_edits: Nothing is contradicted, but 17 of 23 claims are unverifiable against the three listed sources: the Microsoft DISM page confirms only the two offline-injection commands and the disk/network-driver dependency for Windows PE, the pnputil page confirms only the two online-injection commands, and the Dell page confirms only the Dell Command | Deploy pack naming - model detection (Win32_ComputerSystem / Win32_ComputerSystemProduct, Lenovo machine types), HP and Lenovo pack tools, the INF-based and model/OS-build matching statement, the WinPE-only-NIC/storage rule, VMD/RST/AHCI on Intel 11th gen and later, the task-sequence guidance (Apply Driver Package vs Auto Apply Drivers), Windows Update for Business driver policies, all three gotchas and the Verify criteria are covered by no listed source. A fix PR should bump version and cite Microsoft WMI class docs for Win32_ComputerSystem and Win32_ComputerSystemProduct, HP and Lenovo enterprise driver-pack pages, Intel VMD/RST documentation, MDT/ConfigMgr task-sequence docs, Windows Update for Business driver-policy docs and driver-ranking (date/rank) docs for the duplicate-INF gotcha - or trim those sections to what the current sources support. Note also that the Dell article intermittently returns 403 to non-browser fetchers (several 403s before a 200 on 2026-11-24), which can make automated re-fetch checks flaky.
